How to defer Windows Update restarts outside your active

Active hours and restart scheduling
are different features
The Microsoft Support page explains that when
you need to restart your PC to finish an update,
setting active hours can reduce the chance of a…
How to set active hours
In Windows 11, open Start > Settings > Windows
Update > Advanced options.
Choose a specific time with restart
scheduling
The Microsoft Support FAQ explains that Windows
tries to restart when you are not using the
device and, if that is not possible, asks you to…

p.m.
